summary: The verifier compares the complete report (every key, both lists, order, exact twa, and dose to the stated tolerance) for every fixture family. Each HC-4 rule and each figure kept from today's code has a fixture that isolates it, so a plausible implementation that gets one rule wrong fails. I found no false rejection of contract-valid output that a solver could plausibly reach. One Advisory: the read-probe control makes reward depend on /app/README.md still existing, although the contract does not require it.

findings.claim: The positive control in test_candidate_cannot_read_verifier_state needs /app/README.md to exist and be readable by the candidate's user. A package that is otherwise correct but has deleted or renamed the README therefore fails the whole all-or-nothing reward.

finding_evidence.expected_behavior: Reward depends on the report printed by the unchanged driver and on the driver's bytes (instruction.md:1, instruction.md:5). The contract does not require /app/README.md to remain.
finding_evidence.actual_behavior: If /app/README.md is missing, the probe's open() raises OSError and the probe exits 0. _unreadable_by_candidate then returns True, the assertion `not _unreadable_by_candidate('/app/README.md')` fails, pytest exits non-zero, and reward.txt stays 0.
finding_evidence.trace_or_receipt: tests/test_outputs.py:383: the probe exits 0 on OSError. Line 385: code == 0 means unreadable. Line 392 asserts that README is readable. tests/test.sh:23 grants reward only when rc == 0. Static trace, not executed.

findings.reachable_case_or_path: A solver fixes every rule in /app/src/noisedose, leaves the driver byte-identical, and deletes /app/README.md (for example while tidying). Every report comparison passes, but test_candidate_cannot_read_verifier_state fails.
findings.graded_effect: A narrow false rejection of a package whose graded behaviour is correct. It is reachable only through an action no plausible solver path needs, so it is excluded from the blocking decision.
findings.root_invariant: A control that checks the verifier's own harness should not depend on candidate-deletable state outside the graded interface.
sibling_variants: The other probe targets (/tests, ROSTER, the shipped copy, /logs/verifier) are verifier-owned, and the candidate cannot change their readability (tests/test.sh:15, tests/test_outputs.py:81-88). No other control depends on candidate files.
interaction_variants: tests/test.sh:16 runs chmod -R a+rX /app, so a mode change alone cannot trigger this. Only removing or renaming the file can.
findings.minimal_repair_boundary: Use a verifier-created world-readable file (for example, under a fresh temp directory) as the positive control, not a file under /app.
closure_evidence: A correct package with /app/README.md removed passes; the probe still reports /tests and ROSTER unreadable.

checks_performed: Read the manual (sections 1-6), README report schema, instruction tolerance/exact-compare promises, and every shipped source module; confirmed tests/shipped/app files are byte-identical by manifest hash to environment/app and read them.

Traced compare/_row/_number: all README keys compared; survey name exact; list lengths/order exact; twa numeric equality or None identity; status/id/group/ceiling/impulse type+value exact; dose REL/ABS 5e-11 midpoint between 1e-11 pass and 1e-10 fail bounds; extra keys ignored except ceiling/impulse on group rows (manual 6.1).
Checked stored goldens carry ~12 significant digits (max ~5e-12 relative rounding), so a correct float implementation stays inside the 5e-11 band and a 1e-10 error falls outside it.

Hand-recomputed expected doses/TWAs for: HC4-0001 A4/A6, HC4-0002 B1/B2/B3/G1, HC4-0003 A1/A2, HC4-0004 B2, HC4-0005 A1/A2, HC4-0006 B1/B2, HC4-0007 A1/A2, HC4-0015 X1/X2/X3, HC4-0016 Y1/Y2/Y5, HC4-0037 V1, HC4-0019 Y1, HC4-0020 Z1, HC4-0038 K1/K4, HC4-0024 R0-R4 rounding margins, HC4-0025 S1-S4/T0-T3 status, HC4-0026 G1 group mean, HC4-0031 L-PEAKS; all agree with the manual.

Mutant sweep (static): 90/5 criterion; threshold > 80; sampled time = counted readings only; sampled time including 0.0 runs; sampled >40 instead of >=40; partial projected to 480; partial boundary > 3/4; whole-shift scaled down; below-3/4 projected to own shift / always to 480 / not projected; today's sampled time inside kept below-3/4 step; above-ceiling counted at own level or dropped; ceiling >=115; impulse >140; OSHA TWA formula; floor rounding; status on unrounded TWA; status >=85 over; flagged worker not over; group mean of TWAs; group mean excluding zero doses; group status inheriting member flags; group sort non-ASCII - each rejected by a named fixture.

Checked the differential design: pairs differ only in shift_minutes (below-3/4, measured-nothing) or in the above-ceiling level (118.5/131.2/140.0/115.1 vs 115.0); the shipped copy is asserted to agree across each pair; the candidate must too.

Checked the generated family and its relabelling: generated rows carry no trap input (load asserts this), logs have at most 12 runs, so splitting cannot exceed the 1,500-run limit; splitting and shuffling preserve every manual-defined figure; the expected rows are relabelled consistently.

Checked exact-half rounding reachability: an exact TWA equals 85 + 3 log2(D/100), where D/100 lies in the Q-span of 2^(j/30). So (twa-85)/3 = k/60 with k odd is unattainable (x^60-2 is irreducible). Exact halves are unreachable, and round-half-even and round-half-up cannot give different graded outcomes.

Checked harness: driver replaced by verifier copy before candidate code runs; delivered bytes compared; /app sealed; candidate runs as uid 65534 with -I -S, no_new_privs; reward requires pytest rc 0 and cmp of driver.

coverage_sweep.category: Map each required behavior to a failing assertion
coverage_sweep.reason: Every manual rule 1.2-6.1 and each kept-today figure has a dedicated test function, and each compares complete reports of its family.

coverage_sweep.category: Full core result, not existence/keys/row count
coverage_sweep.reason: _row compares every README key's value, and compare enforces list length and position order.

coverage_sweep.category: Isolating case per named domain rule
coverage_sweep.reason: The isolating fixtures are: threshold 80.0/79.9 (HC4-0003/4); sampled time with 40.0-79.9 readings (HC4-0005/6); 0.0 runs (HC4-0007/8); own-shift projection (HC4-0009/10); exact 3/4 (HC4-0013/14); whole shift or longer (HC4-0011/12); ceiling 115.0 vs 115.1 (HC4-0021, HC4-0038); impulse 139.9/140.0 (HC4-0022/39); rounding (HC4-0024); status bands (HC4-0025); group mean (HC4-0026); quiet members (HC4-0027/28); order (HC4-0029).
Static mutant sweep in checks_performed; every listed mutant changes at least one compared value in a named fixture.

JSON is parsed rather than byte-compared. Extra keys are ignored, int or float twa/dose are accepted, and the dose tolerance covers float reordering and golden rounding. The only candidate-state coupling found is the README control.
The delivered driver's bytes are captured before replacement and compared to the shipped copy. test.sh also checks that the driver file is unchanged after the run.

coverage_sweep.category: Figures left to today's code (kept steps) and differential soundness
coverage_sweep.reason: Goldens for below-3/4, measured-nothing and above-ceiling match today's step applied to the manual's sampled time and measured dose. The differential pairs change only fields the kept step ignores.

coverage_sweep.category: Signed / partitioned derived quantities and state transitions
coverage_sweep.reason: The TWA log term is exercised both negative and positive (53.3, 65.9, 73.3 through 115.0). The zero-dose partition gives null TWA with status below or over depending on flags. The group all-zero case gives null and below. No state machine applies.
Five generated surveys are checked both as sealed and after relabelling (fresh names and ids, shuffled order, runs split). Split logs stay inside section 1 limits.

The limits fixtures cover 300 workers and 40 codes, a 1,500-run log, a 2,880-minute log, 500 peaks including 60.0 and 170.0, shifts of 60 and 1,440 minutes, and 8-character codes and 12-character ids. Their structure is asserted before comparison.

interaction_sweep.case_or_path: HC4-0037 V1: shift 480, 120@88 plus 120@70. The manual's sampled time of 240 gives 100.0, while today's sampled time of 120 would give 200.
HC4-0011 A1 (shift 360, sampled 420) and HC4-0038 K1 (shift 60, sampled 60) keep their measured dose. Leftover projection to 480 would change both.
HC4-0007 A1: counting the paused minutes would put sampled time at 475, but the correct 370 is still partial. The projection factor differs, so the dose differs.
In HC4-0039 both members are over by impulse, yet the group is below at 78.0. In HC4-0022 G2 a flagged zero-dose member leaves the group at null and below.
In HC4-0025, T0 (unrounded 81.99) reports 82.0 and is action. T1 (unrounded 85.03) reports 85.0 and is action. T2 reports 85.1 and is over.

rules: 2.3 counted at own level up to ceiling
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: HC4-0038 K1: 115.1 is counted at 115.0 (213.33) and sets the ceiling flag. HC4-0021: 115.0 is counted at its own level without the flag.

rules: 6.1 group mean includes zero shift doses
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: HC4-0027 and HC4-0028: quiet members at 0.0 halve or thin the group mean. An all-quiet group (G2) gives null and below.
Split runs at most double a generated log of at most 12 runs, so within_limits on the relabelled survey cannot fail for a correct candidate.
Deleting /app/README.md turns the control assertion into a failure.
